facts.fact: The APDPVP plenary, by deliberation n°073 of 25 April 2024 on a complaint of 27 November 2023, imposed a pecuniary sanction of 90,000,000 FCFA on Citibank Gabon S.A. for diverting employee data from its declared purpose and processing ethnic-origin data, with a two-month formal notice.
The deliberation applies loi n°025/2023 of 12 July 2023, amending loi n°001/2011 on personal data protection, as law in force, citing its articles 43, 75, 203 and 204.

The APDPVP sat in plenary on 25 April 2024 with a named president, vice-president and six other permanent commissioners, appointed by a Council of Ministers decision of 12 July 2023 and with a bureau elected on 6 September 2023.
